dynamicViews.name: Dynamic View: Parameter Pilot

relationships.description: 1. Start sign-in
2. Authorisation code + PKCE; obtain API access token
3. Send API request with access token, not ID token
4. APIM validates token; Tracking independently validates token/permissions
5. Workload authentication plus verified actor/tank context; authorise access
6. Resolve trusted identity to internal user and single-owner tank
7. Only if authorised, read owned tank history
8. Return allowed data; fail closed if required context unavailable
9. Present authorised result or safe error

dynamicViews.title: Dynamic - Customer sign-in and authorised tank access

dynamicViews.description: SQL state and outbox commit atomically. Publication is outside that transaction; send then crash can republish the same message ID.
dynamicViews.name: Dynamic View: Parameter Pilot

relationships.description: 1. POST tank
2. Authorise and validate
3. COMMIT tank + ownership + TankCreated outbox in one SQL transaction
4. Return 201 after durable commit; broker can be unavailable
5. Relay function reads pending outbox
6. Publish TankCreated to Aquarium events topic; stable event ID
7. Record dispatch only after broker acceptance; retry may duplicate

dynamicViews.title: Outbox - Aquarium tank creation

dynamicViews.description: One Aquarium rule/eligibility batch before an all-or-nothing local commit. Stale revision or unavailable validation saves neither panel nor outbox. Accepted /tankId partition; state and outbox must share the same container.
dynamicViews.name: Dynamic View: Parameter Pilot

relationships.description: 1. Submit panel with definition IDs/revisions, values and units
2. One batch: authorise tank and retrieve selected active definitions/revisions/units/input rules
3. After trusted validation, COMMIT panel + idempotency + outbox in one partition
4. Confirm saved; stale rules/unavailable Aquarium instead return actionable error with no write
5. Relay reads pending outbox
6. Publish MeasurementPanelRecorded to Tracking events topic
7. Record broker acceptance; duplicates remain possible

dynamicViews.title: Outbox - Tracking measurement recording

dynamicViews.description: Two local PostgreSQL transactions surround external work. Outbox relay and command processing are different functions in the same worker app; no exactly-once inference claim.
dynamicViews.name: Dynamic View: Parameter Pilot

relationships.description: 1. Submit authorised advice request
2. COMMIT job + quota reservation + GenerateAdvice outbox
3. Return 202 and job Location after commit
4. Relay reads pending GenerateAdvice command
5. Send stable command ID to Advisor advice queue
6. Record dispatch after broker acceptance
7. Advice handler receives command; idempotent lease
8. Authorised profile and entitlement
9. Authorised reading/history context
10. Save submitted-input snapshot; retrieve pgvector references
11. Request text inference; no photos
12. COMMIT result + terminal job + quota settlement + AdviceCompleted outbox
13. Relay reads completion outbox
14. Publish AdviceCompleted to Advisor events topic
15. Record completion dispatch after broker acceptance

dynamicViews.title: Outbox - Advisor request and completion

dynamicViews.description: UI retains input on stale-definition or Aquarium-unavailable errors; no new panel/outbox is saved on validation failure.
dynamicViews.name: Dynamic View: Parameter Pilot

relationships.description: 1. Open measurement entry for tank
2. Request tank-selected definitions/units/revisions
3. Get authorised entry configuration
4. Read selected GUID definitions and scientific revisions
5. Submit panel with IDs/revisions, values, units and measured time
6. Validate shape/authentication
7. Batch all references once: tank eligibility, active revisions, units and authoritative rules
8. If complete panel validates, atomically save panel/idempotency/outbox
9. Return 201 only after durable commit; invalid/stale/unavailable means no new save
10. Confirm saved, or preserve input and offer refresh/retry
11. Relay function reads persisted outbox asynchronously
12. Publish MeasurementPanelRecorded; duplicates possible

dynamicViews.title: Dynamic - Batched rule validation, measurement panel commit and outbox publication

relationships.description: 1. Opens trend view
2. Request historical measurements
3. Query measurements
4. Read historical data
5. Return measurements
6. Return trend data
7. Return trend data

dynamicViews.name: Dynamic View: Parameter Pilot

relationships.description: 1. Request advice
2. POST advice request
3. Authorise request and entitlement
4. Commit job/quota reservation/outbox
5. Return 202 and job Location
6. Relay persisted GenerateAdvice command
7. Send command to Advisor queue
8. Advice function receives command; claim lease idempotently
9. Get scoped profile/entitlement
10. Get scoped history via owner API; no direct Cosmos read
11. Preserve submitted context; retrieve curated passages with pgvector
12. Infer text advice without photos
13. Validate/store result, settle quota and write completion outbox

dynamicViews.title: Dynamic - Registered advice job processed by Advisor Async Worker

dynamicViews.name: Dynamic View: Parameter Pilot

relationships.description: 1. Select photo; UI rejects above 5242880 bytes
2. Authenticated binary upload; no browser Blob SAS
3. Stream upload; enforce actual 5242880-byte file cap; 413 on excess
4. Save within-limit private original after bounded validation
5. Register uploaded metadata and durable processing work
6. Relay durable photo-processing command from outbox
7. Publish ProcessPhoto command to Tracking queue
8. Tracking photo function receives command idempotently
9. Validate original; create cropped 400x400 thumbnail and padded 1200x800 hero WebP; retain original
10. Mark Ready only when both derivatives and metadata are durable; completion outbox

dynamicViews.title: Dynamic - Upload via Tracking and generate WebP images

relationships.description: 1. Scroll Advice history and select an item
2. Request owner-scoped history page or detail
3. Validate access and query history
4. Read historic advice and original submitted parameter snapshot
5. Return history page or selected advice with submitted values
6. Display advice and original values; not current readings
